turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: Sawubona, my name is Bongani from Umoya Networks. This call may be recorded.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Sawubona. My fibre has been down for three days, inkinga enkulu, and I work from home.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: I'm sorry to hear that. Ngicela your ID number and your address?

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Eight zero zero one, and twelve Main Road, Soweto.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: Thank you. I can see a fault in your area. A technician will come tomorrow morning and you will get an SMS with a reference number.
